name: Sioux Manufacturing Corporation
old_description: Sioux Manufacturing Corporation is a Native American owned business operating out of a 250,000 sq. ft. facility located on the Spirit Lake Nation in Fort Totten, North Dakota.
about:
Sioux Manufacturing Corporation was founded in 1976 in Fort Totten, North Dakota, on the Spirit Lake Nation. The company is a Native American‑owned business operating from a 250,000‑square‑foot facility.

The company produces composite molded components for defense applications. Its capabilities span prepreg cutting with Lectra Vector 2500 vertical knife cutters and slitter sheeters, compression molding on hydraulic presses ranging from 200 to 1,500 tons, autoclave molding up to 175 psi and 500 °F, and CNC machining via four abrasive waterjet centers and five 3‑axis machining centers. Finishing services include bonding, hardware installation, priming, painting, and final assembly in two paint booths and a grit‑blast booth. Quality assurance covers receiving, in‑process, and final inspection using an Instron dual‑column test system, a Hexagon Global CMM, a FaroArm 3D measuring arm, and an on‑site ballistics range.

Sioux Manufacturing’s primary customer is the U.S. Department of Defense, to which it has supplied quality products for over 50 years. The company’s output supports defense programs requiring composite structures and assemblies.

The firm emphasizes continuous quality improvement, cost control, and on‑time delivery as the foundation of its customer satisfaction philosophy. Its hiring strategy focuses on retaining skilled personnel to maintain technical expertise and regional economic contribution.
